children: Bahrain’s Electricity and Water Authority (EWA) is expected to award the Sitra Independent Water and Power Project (IWPP) in the fourth quarter of 2026, according to a source familiar with the project.
The tender was issued in August 2025, with bids submitted on 17 May 2026 and the tender opening taking place on 3 September 2026.
“The contract is expected to be awarded in November 2026,” the source told Zawya Projects, adding that the project is scheduled for completion in the second quarter of 2029.
The source said his estimates show the investment cost of the project at $1.5 billion.
The project is being procured under a Build-Own-Operate (BOO) model.

The original prequalification covered a facility with 1,200 megawatts (MW) of power generation capacity and 30 million imperial gallons per day (MIGD) of water production capacity. The subsequent Request for Proposals (RFP) increased the power requirement to 1,400-1,500MW.
TAQA and ACWA Power are bidding for the project but the tender board notice didn’t disclose their actual commercial offers other than indicating that both bids were accepted.
When the proposals were initially opened on 18 June, ACWA Power's bid was recorded as accepted, while TAQA's bid was accepted with conditions.
Six companies and a consortium had been prequalified to bid for the mega project, according to the Request for Proposal (RFP) notice issued in August 2025.
(Reporting by Deva Palanisamy; Editing by Anoop Menon)
